intent: Low and close from the open floor: her two feet in white socks (no shoes) standing with their weight on two legs of the chair’s black five-star base (r4, Jade: both feet on the wheely part), each sole square on top of a leg, toes and heel over the edges; the hub and gas column, the twin-wheel casters; Dad’s grey socks and brown slippers beyond. The c. 1990 task chair is black nylon base and casters, charcoal blue-grey tweed seat. The screen light comes over the desk edge from frame left; the desk cuts it, so the foot nearer the desk is in shadow.

beam.name: CRT screen glow
beam.model: area source (the screen rectangle), radiating into +z; frustum spreading by half_angle from the rectangle, faded out at range
beam.corner_order: TL,TR,BR,BL as the screen is read
beam.falloff: inverse-square from an area source: full on faces 0.4-0.6 m away, about 1/10 at 1.5 m

floor.note: the desk top cuts the light: floor nearer the desk than desk_shadow_ends_z, and everything under the desk, is unlit
